documents.title: Proxy Config (self-documenting)
documents.description: All server settings + secrets: port, refresh_minutes, player_source (fifa), apifootball_season, api_football_key, openrouter_api_key, ai_access_password, allow_origins — each explained in an inline _notes block.

documents.title: Shared Build Config
documents.description: Key-sanitized config baked into the portable build so a shared binary never leaks the owner's keys.

documents.title: Config Editor (UI)
documents.description: One-page editor for config.json, served local-only at GET /config/editor (refused over the tunnel).

documents.title: FastAPI Proxy
documents.description: The service. Serves WC2026.html at /, exposes /snapshot /health /fixtures /players /teams /kalshi /refresh, the AI relays (/ai/openrouter, /ai/ollama/*), and local-only /config*. refresh() fetch-score-cache pipeline + APScheduler + warm cache.

documents.title: Data Sources
documents.description: Server-side fetchers: ESPN fixtures/standings/bracket, EA FC 26 ratings → national squads, optional API-Football deep stats, Kalshi live odds with self-healing series discovery, and a SAMPLE fallback.

documents.title: Scoring Engine
documents.description: Transparent heuristic: position-aware percentile PPS (score_players), rated-input scoring (score_all_rated), and projected-XI squad strength SSS (score_team) with star bonus + bench depth.

documents.title: AI Grounding Audit
documents.description: Sends the page's persona prompt + JSON snapshot through the live /ai/openrouter and checks the AI stays grounded in the panels and refuses outside info.

documents.title: API-Football Key Test
documents.description: Verifies a configured API-Football key against /status (same check as GET /apifootball/check).

documents.title: The App (single-file front end)
documents.description: The entire UI in one ~97 KB file: board assembly + /snapshot polling, the betting-window math (winProb=p^rounds), the unified multi-provider AI call, the Kalshi list + market edge, and the persistent dynamic workspace.

documents.title: Windowed Launcher
documents.description: Runs the proxy in a background thread and opens the app in a native OS webview window (pywebview). Entry point for the default windowed build.

documents.title: Console Launcher
documents.description: The older browser-launch entry point used by the --console build variant.

documents.title: Run Proxy (local)
documents.description: Starts the proxy locally for development (python server.py on :8710).
